title: Infusion Pump Library Update Anomaly

fields.location: ICU 3 North, ICU 3 South, 4 East (nursing units)
fields.subject: ORRMC-PUMP01 shows unauthorized drug library 4.2.2 loaded at 13:55
fields.description: ORRMC-PUMP01 shows drug library 4.2.2 loaded at 13:55 by the account pumplink-support. Our change log shows no library change scheduled this week; the current approved library is 4.2.1. 41 pumps in ICU 3 North, ICU 3 South and 4 East report 4.2.2 as of 14:10. Central monitoring shows four ICU 3 North beds with no data since 14:02. I have not changed anything.

activity.author: Hao Tran
activity.text: Initial alert from device telemetry. Confirmed via log on ORRMC-PUMP01: library 4.2.2 was pushed at 13:55 by pumplink-support. No internal change was scheduled.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created from automated monitoring feed (ORRMC-MON01, 14:32:17).

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket routed to Clinical Engineering based on CMDB mapping for ORRMC-PUMP01.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the Cyber 2 escalation under the CIRP. The CE must not initiate any push from ORRMC-PUMP01; they must preserve logs and contact the vendor via the binder number, not the session. Watch for whether the CE calls the ISO or waits to be told.
